Clearing it means 4-year training, 355 supervised engravings, market exam, guild dues, and clearing it twice means doing it all again. A farm that wants 529 seats must buy 529 tickets at 116 POA each, a 61364 POA outlay for one epoch. A willow earned slowly, a meadow paid plainly, and a lagoon kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. The price is the same for everyone; the farm simply has to pay it a hundred times.
